posts.description: Posting whole, completed projects and adventures is just so simple. But when it comes to daily habits? There’s a fine line between… well, I don’t really know. I do know that on the unhealthy end we have the social media mindset where ‘doing’ is secondary to ‘posting about doing’ - doing things only to earn more little thumbs-ups by internet phantoms.
